Name the following processes of erosion:
Air becomes trapped in joints and cracks on a cliff face. When waves break, the trapped
air is compressed, weakening the cliff and causing erosion.
Bits of rock and sand carried by waves grind down cliff surfaces, like sandpaper.
Waves smash rocks and pebbles on the shore into each other, and these break and
become smoother.
